tools.name: get_studio_overview
tools.description: Concise overview of Novaeon: what the studio builds, how it works and links to every page. Markdown.

tools.name: get_full_content
tools.description: The complete site copy (all sections) as one markdown document (llms-full.txt).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Markdown version of one novaeon.studio page. Examples: "/", "/ro/", "/de/", "/legal-notice", "/privacy".

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Send an inquiry to Novaeon on behalf of a person (same as the contact form; they reply by email). Requires the person's name, email, company and role, a description of the need and their consent. Rate limited.

tools.name: find_service
tools.description: Finds the Novaeon services and industry pages that match a need, e.g. "automate invoice processing in SAP" or "AI agent for our sales pipeline". English keywords work best. Returns the best matches with URL and summary.

tools.name: get_free_slots
tools.description: Free 30-minute slots for the Agent Strategy Call with Novaeon (video call, Teams or Zoom). Each slot has the start in UTC and in Europe/Bucharest time.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Books a free 30-minute Agent Strategy Call with Novaeon in a free slot, on behalf of a person. The slot is reserved at once; the person gets a confirmation email with a calendar file and Novaeon sends the meeting link. Rate limited.
